summary: Feed s097_single is degraded: 56.5% of TCP sessions (65/115) are one-way, so IDS lacks bidirectional visibility for stateful inspection. All other checks (duplicates, drops, overload, VLAN, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP is delivering only one direction per session to this IDS port. Most likely cause is SPAN configured for one direction only, single-sided TAP on asymmetric path, or hash-based distribution without bidirectional affinity splitting client->server and server->client to different tools.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true for TCP reassembly and signature matching. With 56.5% one-way sessions it cannot reconstruct streams, misses exploits and C2 callbacks, and produces incomplete/false alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow to the same IDS port using 5-tuple affinity so the IDS receives complete bidirectional sessions for stateful detection.
